Name: Toolkit self-test
Description: Generates dummy results without touching any tenant. Use it to check that the GUI, logging, dry-run, cancel and CSV export all work.
Author: Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: Count
Parameters.Label: Number of sample rows
Parameters.HelpText: Each row takes ~0.3 s, so you can try Cancel.

Parameters.Name: EmitWarning
Parameters.Label: Warnings
Parameters.HelpText: Write a sample warning to the log

Parameters.Name: Fail
Parameters.Label: Failure
Parameters.HelpText: Throw an error at the end to see how failures look
